answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind each identity to an exponential stake burn: the cost to register the k-th agent scales superlinearly as C(k) = S * 2^k. Even if malicious operators whisper collusion secrets or use cheap copper hardware to mass-produce bot signatures, burning native collateral acts like permanent pigment indelibly staining their balance sheet. This quadratic-to-exponential economic friction makes aggregate attacking costs explode while honest participation remains linearly affordable.
